cur_batch = tl.program_id(0)
    cur_head = tl.program_id(1)
    start_m = tl.program_id(2)

    cur_batch_in_all_start_index = tl.load(B_Start_Loc + cur_batch)
    cur_batch_seq_len = tl.load(B_Seqlen + cur_batch)

    offs_m = start_m * BLOCK_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)
    m_mask = offs_m < cur_batch_seq_len
    if not tl.any(m_mask):
        return

    offs_d = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_DMODEL)
    d_mask = offs_d < Lk

    q_offs = (
        (cur_batch_in_all_start_index + offs_m[:, None]) * stride_qbs
        + cur_head * stride_qh
        + offs_d[None, :]
    )
    q = tl.load(Q + q_offs, mask=m_mask[:, None] & d_mask[None, :], other=0.0)

    kv_head = cur_head // kv_group_num

    m_i = tl.full((BLOCK_M,), float('-inf'), dtype=tl.float32)
    l_i = tl.zeros((BLOCK_M,), dtype=tl.float32)
    acc = tl.zeros((BLOCK_M, BLOCK_DMODEL), dtype=tl.float32)

    lo = 0
    hi = cur_batch_seq_len
    for start_n in range(lo, hi, BLOCK_N):
        start_n = tl.multiple_of(start_n, BLOCK_N)
        offs_n = start_n + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)
        n_mask = offs_n < cur_batch_seq_len

        k_offs = (
            (cur_batch_in_all_start_index + offs_n[None, :]) * stride_kbs
            + kv_head * stride_kh
            + offs_d[:, None]
        )
        k = tl.load(K + k_offs, mask=d_mask[:, None] & n_mask[None, :], other=0.0)

        qk = tl.dot(q, k).to(tl.float32) * sm_scale

        mask = m_mask[:, None] & n_mask[None, :]
        if IS_CAUSAL:
            mask = mask & (offs_m[:, None] >= offs_n[None, :])
        if SLIDING_WINDOW_Q > 0:
            mask = mask & ((offs_m[:, None] - offs_n[None, :]) <= SLIDING_WINDOW_Q)
        if SLIDING_WINDOW_K > 0:
            mask = mask & ((offs_n[None, :] - offs_m[:, None]) <= SLIDING_WINDOW_K)
        qk = tl.where(mask, qk, float('-inf'))

        m_ij = tl.maximum(m_i, tl.max(qk, 1))
        p = tl.exp(qk - m_ij[:, None])
        l_ij = tl.sum(p, 1)
        alpha = tl.exp(m_i - m_ij)
        l_i = l_i * alpha + l_ij
        acc = acc * alpha[:, None]

        v_offs = (
            (cur_batch_in_all_start_index + offs_n[:, None]) * stride_vbs
            + kv_head * stride_vh
            + offs_d[None, :]
        )
        v = tl.load(V + v_offs, mask=n_mask[:, None] & d_mask[None, :], other=0.0)
        acc += tl.dot(p.to(v.dtype), v)
        m_i = m_ij

    acc = acc / l_i[:, None]

    out_offs = (
        (cur_batch_in_all_start_index + offs_m[:, None]) * stride_obs
        + cur_head * stride_oh
        + offs_d[None, :]
    )
    tl.store(Out + out_offs, acc.to(Q.dtype.element_ty), mask=m_mask[:, None] & d_mask[None, :])
